body.name: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}\) (baseline event-transfer class)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY},0}=\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}:\mathsf A_{\mathrm{ind}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{ctr}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{subG}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{var}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rowvar}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{vrep}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{vrep}})\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{rank}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{inc}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{sig}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{sig}})\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{spec}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{spec}})\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{block}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{block}})\wedge\mathsf A_A((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_B((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{nd}}((P_n))\wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{lev}}((P_n);\varepsilon^{\mathrm{lev}})\}\). Every member property holds at each finite \(n\) with the common event-transfer constants and fixed envelopes in the symbol table.  This exact-rank, blockwise-uniform, row-heteroskedastic class is not the published Choi--Yuan approximate-rank class; the superscript records the provenance of the block coefficients.
